scope: Short module integration: real ID/decoder, scoreboard, CSR buffer, commit_stage, CSR regfile, controller and acc_dispatcher. Scalar operands/delayed writeback and request-triggered accelerator response are BFMs. Not a whole-core, MMU, accelerator datapath, SoC or board test.
source_contract: All RTL copied byte-for-byte from /home/wangwy/openproject/ara_dsa. Shared inputs must match resident_direct_rtl_gate_unit_20261114_01/source-pins.json; cva6.sv supplies production types, not full-core elaboration.
legal_stimulus: Real ID and scoreboard allocate every instruction and transaction ID. AKV valid=0 means no completion yet, not an absent scoreboard entry. Actual commit_stage drives CSR op/data, exception, ack and macro_ack; no TB ack or force.

CSR address is latched by real csr_buffer from issued operand_b. The scalar WB BFM deliberately withholds completion while younger instructions reach ID/queue. This is module-boundary stimulus, not proof of whole-core timing reachability.
SAKVCTL close uses S control=5 to 1. S reopening uses denied NONE/illegal entries, never fabricated ACCEL. M control=1 to 3 provides the legal opening race since M is always allowed.

Trap uses delayed LOAD_PAGE_FAULT WB and real commit exception. MEDELEG selects S; the final denied AKV illegal exception is not delegated and enters M. Actual MRET/SRET use the CSR-maintained privilege stack.

No forced ready bits or impossible filled-output scenario. On CSR/xRET race acc_commit && pending[id] is nonzero, flush blocks pop and overrides ready next-state. Every replay uses real ID 1 again, waits three cycles behind incomplete ID 0, then requires its own real ack0 without flush.

The response BFM responds one cycle after an actual request handshake, never before. It returns token+1; real scoreboard WB and commit retire the matching AKV. Output is empty on each tested flush, so already-authorized non-flushable requests are not falsely required to disappear.

cases.name: csr_close_open_s
cases.purpose: Close allowed S with pending port1/held ID; reopen using genuine denied entries; same-ID replay waits then sends once.

cases.name: csr_open_m_mret_u
cases.purpose: Open U permission in M with pending port1; replay; MRET with old M queue/ID cleared; fresh allowed U replay.

cases.name: u_only_trap_sret
cases.purpose: Control=3: allowed U queue/ID flushed by delegated trap to denied S; denied S state flushed by SRET; allowed U replay.

cases.name: s_only_trap_sret_mret
cases.purpose: Control=5: denied U trap to allowed S; positive S replay; SRET clears old allowed state; denied AKV traps to M; MRET clears old M state to denied U.

counter_semantics.checks: Every TB check, including cycle invariants; setup checks belong to the active case.
counter_semantics.requests: req_valid && req_ready at rising edge, actual accelerator interface transfer.
counter_semantics.pops: Speculative instruction queue pop at rising edge, distinct from accelerator acceptance/retirement.
counter_semantics.retires: Actual commit macro_ack & ~drop on port0 for completed ACCEL with response-derived result.
counter_semantics.rejects: Checked denied INFO instances explicitly sent through issue (NONE/illegal) plus final denied held-ID refetch; other held-ID denial checks do not increment.
counter_semantics.flushes: Completed boundary() scenarios only; excludes setup CSR/xRET flushes and the additional illegal-to-M trap. CSV records every flush cycle.
counter_semantics.replays: Completed allowed same-ID replay scenarios, each exactly one request/pop/retire.
counter_semantics.races: Completed CSR/xRET boundary scenarios with old allowed pending AKV, actual ack0 and acc_commit, flush blocking pop/ready persistence.
counter_semantics.waits: Checked stalled-older cycles in replay, exactly three per replay.

result_schema.cases: Ordered array: name plus integer checks, requests, rejects, flushes, replays, pops, retires, races, waits; failure retains completed case marks only.
result_schema.totals: Sum of case numeric fields on PASS; empty on failure.
result_schema.artifacts: simv, compile_log, simulation_log, events_csv: each path and sha256 if present.
result_schema.other_fields: scope, config, event_rows on PASS, whole_core_tested=false, board_tested=false, automatic_retry=false, error/pin_error on failure

marks: COMMIT_BOUNDARY_CASE_PASS name=<name> checks=<n> requests=<n> rejects=<n> flushes=<n> replays=<n> pops=<n> retires=<n> races=<n> waits=<n>
COMMIT_BOUNDARY_PASS cases=4 checks=<n> requests=<n> rejects=<n> flushes=<n> replays=<n> pops=<n> retires=<n> races=<n> waits=<n>
event_log: simulation/events.csv: one row per rising edge, pre-NBA state. Decimal controls/IDs; csr_addr, csr_wdata, pending, ready, req_insn, req_rs1 are hex. Includes setup/reset and phase names; no filtering. Request/pop/retirement CSV totals independently cross-checked against marks.
execution_policy: Prepare only until main-thread review. Direct systemd worker; host VCS, 180s compile + 30s sim, 270s service cap; no retries, production edits, Verilator, URG or ZCC. Keep first failure and all evidence.
